title: xanthisma berlandieri
intro: Xanthisma berlandieri, commonly known as Berlandier's goldeneye, is a flowering plant species native to North America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and supporting digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Xanthisma berlandieri include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
